findings.description: Recommendation for Interactive Elements Missing Name, Role, or Value lacks specific data anchors; generic guidance on accessible names and roles.
Recommendation for Insufficient Colour Contrast provides only general advice to raise contrast ratios without referencing specific elements or selectors.
Recommendation for Info and Relationships Not Programmatically Determined offers generic instructions on exposing structure, lacking concrete data points.
Recommendation for Accessibility Issue (missing submit button) gives broad remediation steps without specific element references or counts.
Recommendation for Image Alt-text Coverage suggests adding alt text generically, no selector or image count reference.
Recommendation for Heading Hierarchy Skips Levels gives generic ordering advice without specific heading instances.
Recommendation for Main Landmark Absent prescribes adding a <main> tag generically, no page or selector details.
Recommendation for Semantic Structure (Naked Containers) advises replacing landmark containers with semantic elements without specifying selectors or counts.
Recommendation for Security headers absent provides generic header addition instructions, no specific server config details.
Recommendation for No Schema.org structured data offers generic schema additions without referencing specific entity types or selectors.
Recommendation for No llms.txt published prescribes publishing the file generically, no path specifics beyond root.
Recommendation for No sitemap.xml similarly gives generic guidance without specific URL or selector details.
